papers.text: A bandstand for the tuba alone, by the water. The band asked.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Your name on every bus. Then every stop. Then every destination.
papers.subject: vanity

papers.text: A sign by the pond, facing the pumpkins: LOOK AT SOMETHING ELSE.
papers.subject: signage

papers.text: The bandstand overlooks four bus stops. Spotters ask for Sundays.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Conduct the band for one bar. One. We will tell you which.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: A review: is a pumpkin in a window a display, or a vegetable?
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The review finds it is both. It asks for a third category.

papers.text: A step for spotters outside the shops. Facing the road. Mostly.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: A shop window for the tuba, please. Then the cornets. Then the drum.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: A hut out of earshot of the band. Cuthbert is measuring earshot.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Rename the river after you. You reflect well on 300 metres of it.
papers.subject: vanity

papers.text: Receive the Brass Thimble on the steps. Hold it up, so it shows.
papers.subject: ceremonies

papers.text: The bandstand for the pumpkins in autumn. They have never had a roof.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: The Guild will sponsor the sheet music. Each page ends: SEE OUR HATS.
papers.subject: hats

papers.text: A committee to decide whether a bus seen in a shop window counts as seen.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The committee has seen a bus in a puddle. It asks for a year.

papers.text: A copy of the founding napkin for a shop window. Pressed, for once.
papers.subject: ceremonies

papers.text: A hat for the Ceremonial Spoon. One for its stand. One for you?
papers.subject: hats

favour.text: The spoon's hat would like a shop window of its own. The best one.

clippings.sign: SPOON'S HAT GETS BEST WINDOW; GOVERNOR CUTS RIBBON
clippings.refuse: HAT SENT BACK; SPOON BAREHEADED BUT CALM

papers.text: Move the bus stop off the bridge. Each bus makes four anglers look up.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: A working group on whether an onion may be applauded, or only the band.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: Somebody clapped. The working group asks for a further year.

papers.text: Wear the beetroot's rosette for the photograph. It has agreed.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: The band will hire the riverbank to rehearse quietly. For a band.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Muffle the shop bells by the river. Unmuffling on written request.
papers.subject: paperwork

papers.text: An inquiry into which way up sheet music goes. Then which way round.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The inquiry has found a third way up. It needs a year to try it.

papers.text: Another basket. The grapes are provincial now. Ribbons? No reason.
papers.subject: ribbons

favour.text: The provincial grapes wish to enter the show. In the pumpkin class.

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR'S GRAPES ENTER PUMPKIN CLASS; JUDGES SILENT
clippings.refuse: GRAPES WITHDRAWN FROM SHOW, EATEN AT TEA

papers.text: Lend us the pond on Tuesdays, for watering. Down about one heron.
papers.subject: gardens

papers.text: Brass bunting for the high street. It does not flap. It clangs.
papers.subject: ribbons

papers.text: Pose with the Anglers for a photograph. Keep still until autumn.
papers.subject: portraits

papers.text: A sign over the shops: BUS DUE SHORTLY. Shortly to be defined.
papers.subject: signage

papers.text: Give the band's Sunday to the Anglers. They will do nothing with it.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Your signature on every tuba. Then every cornet. Then the triangle.
papers.subject: vanity

papers.text: A survey to confirm the river is still flowing. Monthly, from a bench.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: Findings: it flows. A second year is needed to learn which way.

papers.text: Till's Teas would like tables on the riverbank. Whispered orders.
papers.subject: gardens

papers.text: The Circle will pay to name the 6:10. They would call it nothing.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: We will pay to name a shelter after our founder's notebook. 41,000 buses.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: A platform by the pumpkins, facing the pumpkins. Not the road.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: Wave at the 8:20. It will be logged as an official wave, in ink.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: We will pay to list our show in the timetable. Then results. Then weights.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: A working group on noise. It will meet in silence, so may take a while.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The working group on noise asks for a second room. The first one echoed.

papers.text: A sign by the vegetable beds: PUMPKINS GROWING. NO TUBA.
papers.subject: signage
